welcome_page.title: Car – Trip experience and conditions
welcome_page.description:
How secure you feel from crime or harassment when you travel by car. Most questions are answered Yes or No.

Taking part is voluntary and you can skip any question. Your answers are not linked to your name, and no public authority receives them.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

Only the SmartUrbanity research team reads your answers. We keep them for research for 36 months; then we delete them or make them anonymous.

questions.text: During the day, do you ever feel unsafe from crime or harassment when you travel by car? (Harassment includes unwanted comments, following, touching, or intimidating behaviour directed at you.)
In the evening or after dark, do you ever feel unsafe from crime or harassment when you travel by car?
When you feel unsafe in the evening, what do you change?
questions.help: You can choose more than one answer.

options.text: I share my location with someone
I ask someone to come with me
I use a different means of transport

questions.text: When you travel by car, what makes you feel less secure from crime or harassment? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Places with few people around (isolated or deserted areas)
People behaving aggressively or in an intimidating way
Poor maintenance (e.g. abandoned buildings, graffiti, broken infrastructure)
No surveillance or security measures (e.g. no cameras, no staff)
Incidents that happened to me or were reported in the area
Few cues to find my way without sight (e.g. no tactile paths or audio announcements)

questions.text: When you travel by car, have you experienced or do you fear harassment because of who you are or how you look (e.g. gender, appearance, origin, age)?
Compared with other ways of getting around, how comfortable is the car for you?
When you are held up on a car trip, how stressed do you feel?
questions.help: For example traffic jams, crashes or roadworks.

questions.text: Do traffic jams make you change your route or the time you leave?

options.text: Always: I plan my trips to avoid them

questions.text: How hard is it to find a parking space where you go?
questions.help: Think of the places you drive to most often.

options.text: Not for me: I don't drive

questions.text: When parking is hard, what do you usually do?

options.text: I still go, but it's slower or more stressful
I change my route or where I go
I put off, avoid or cancel some trips
I go another way instead (e.g. bus, on foot)

questions.text: How much do charging points affect whether you use an electric car?

options.text: Not for me: my vehicle isn't electric

questions.text: When you travel by car, how much does traffic noise bother or annoy you?
When you travel by car, what do you do when the air is bad (exhaust fumes, dust, bad smells)?

options.text: I notice it, but I don't change anything
I protect myself, e.g. by closing the windows
I take another route or travel at another time
I travel another way (e.g. by metro instead of by car)

questions.text: When you travel by car, what do you usually do when the weather is bad (rain, wind, cold or great heat)?

options.text: Nothing changes, I travel as usual
It's less pleasant, but I travel the same way
I prepare differently or change route (e.g. clothes, umbrella)
I put off or skip some trips
I travel another way (e.g. by taxi or metro)

questions.text: When you travel by car, what do you do when streets or car parks are dirty or badly kept (litter, smells, broken glass)?

options.text: I notice it, but carry on as usual
It's unpleasant, but I still go that way
I avoid some streets or car parks
I stop using that route altogether

questions.text: When you travel by car, do pleasant or unpleasant surroundings affect how you feel?
questions.help: For example buildings, squares, how cared-for a place is and its general feel.

options.text: No, I don't pay attention to them
I notice them, but they rarely make a difference
They affect a lot how I feel on the way
I sometimes choose a route because it's nicer or more interesting

questions.text: When you travel by car, how stressed or relaxed do you usually feel?
When you travel by car, how often do you feel anxious or overwhelmed?
When you travel by car, what makes you feel anxious or overwhelmed?

options.text: Aggressive or careless drivers, riders or pedestrians
Routes that are complicated or new to me
Noise, crowds or too much going on around me
Being in a hurry or afraid of being late
Feeling alone or isolated on the way
Health problems on the way (pain, breathlessness, dizziness)

questions.text: When you travel by car, how do you feel on streets with lots of people, shops and activity?

options.text: I prefer them: I feel safer or more at ease
I like them: they make the trip nicer
It makes no difference to me

questions.text: When you travel by car, how tired do you usually feel when you arrive?
When you travel by car, what tires you most?

options.text: Carrying children, a pushchair or shopping

questions.help: Think of both physical and mental effort. Other ways could be walking, cycling or public transport.

When you travel by car, how satisfied are you overall?
